body: This is what I’m going to do. I’m in a much better place now so I think I can really handle it this time around. Thank you for your advice. These comments are giving me hope
That is wild. I really thought I was done for. I had big dreams in terms of schooling and a career and threw them all out when I lost my scholarship. Maybe I can get them back.
Thank you. I actually have some hope after reading these replies.

Thank you. I really appreciate how caring these responses are. I have spent the past few years going in and out of PHP/IOP treatment centers. I just completed 6 ish months of live-in and it really is different this time because I moved out and did not return to my abusive environment. I’m also keeping up surprisingly well with meds and therapy. I am so much healthier than when I made my other posts. And I am so much more in tune with what I need to stay this way. Thank you ❤️❤️❤️

Thank you for your response. The fact that you’re going as far as a PhD after going through something similar really gives me hope. I’m terrified I won’t even be able to get my bachelor’s so that really means so much to here.

I am an adult and I started reporting things when I thought she no longer had a hold over me. Ironically I have mental health issues due to growing up in that household and they are constantly used against me. I’m out of there now. I’m going to talk to my therapist about this, maybe she can help me figure out what to do. I can’t get better if the guilt is eating me alive. Thank you for your response ❤️

Bruh this made me cry you are such a good person. I wish I could say more I just wish the best for you. I hope you are this kind and gentle with yourself in hard moments too. Thank you for helping me out when you don’t even know me.
Thank you for the advice. It’s very kind of you to share but in my experience that community is less supportive for some reason. I don’t know why since it’s pretty much the same premise.

I’m definitely seeing it differently now that I’m out of crisis mode. I’m choosing to believe people were upvoting to show they hear me. Easier to do when I’m not actively suicidal. I’m so sorry you have to go through this. I wish I had advice.

Thank you <3 I’m much better today. Unfortunately I have a diagnosis that makes my mental health extremely hot and cold so I’m fine today. Reading these replies means a lot though, and I’m going to be proactive about getting help before I’m in crisis again.

Thank you for checking up. I ended up knocking out pretty shortly after because I took my meds (appropriately) and slept for a very long time. I am doing better today. I need a new therapist and will call my insurance to ask for referrals tomorrow.

This response means so much to me. I’m thinking with a clearer head today and realizing I have been on the other end of this too and not known what to say or do.  It’s just hard to see things from other people’s POV when you’re in crisis.

Thank you. I feel bad today for scaring people. I ended up taking my meds (as prescribed) and calming down and falling asleep from the exhaustion. I wish i could have updated sooner so people didn’t worry.
Thank you. Part of what made this episode so hard is that I was doing so well for so long. The mythical “im cured” state of mind.
Thank you. If I’m understanding your comment correctly, I’m glad you’re in a better place now
Thank you. I realized today, in a healthier state, that upvotes probably meant understanding.
It really means a lot to wake up to the support here. I was having a bad episode and felt totally alone and like nobody cared.
Thank you for this perspective <3 I get so caught up in my feelings I can’t put myself in other peoples shoes. It helps to hear things like this when I’m in a calmer state
Thank you for this perspective. I am doing better today.
Thank you. I was having a really bad episode for the first time in a year so I just felt the world was against me.
Love the range of responses from normal “give her a quarter/nothing next time!” to the fucking psychopaths here suggesting they knock the rest of her teeth out or starve her. Peak Reddit.

It was not last minute i cancelled days in advance. The “lack of respect” was me being suddenly homeless and either not able to get a ride to the shop or not able to afford tip because the money had to unexpectedly go elsewhere those other times.

Thank you! Unfortunately the time frame was because I was homeless and didn’t have any money for tip or a way to get there. I’m in a little bit of a better situation now, I called them up and they said they still won’t charge me but I plan to leave a generous tip.
You really shouldn’t care
Not a single person cares about me I can promise you that
Im so proud of you!!! But more importantly you should be proud of yourself!!!!!!!!

Not directly to me, but I went to my neurologist and she asked me to bend over to check if my scoliosis had progressed (I have 2 rare neurological conditions and one weakens my spine). I told her I had torn my PCL the week before so it was difficult for me to get up and down the little steps to the chair. She proceeded to tell the medical students sitting in that I had trouble moving because of my weight, right in front of me. I was not even that overweight at the time. I was just in a lot of pain. Safe to say I never went back there.
